title: Morning DCA live classification block
description: The run_classification object embedded in every MORNING run_state artifact. The morning stream is a LIVE Robinhood execution stream (account 562057042) that is INDEPENDENT of the afternoon live task 10ce362c (which supersedes ce16ba6b). This block makes the separation explicit so afternoon slippage/watchdog/reliability/weekly reporting never treats a morning artifact as afternoon scheduled evidence; morning fills feed the afternoon stream only as prior same-day allocation context for the top-up guard. Contains no secrets.

run_origin.description: Origin of the morning run. 'scheduled' is the 9:45 AM ET morning live task; everything else is 'manual'.

stream.description: Stream marker. Always 'morning' so this artifact is never confused with the afternoon stream.

manual_run.description: true for manual morning runs, false for scheduled morning runs. Must agree with run_origin.

cron_id.description: Morning stream task id. Distinct from the afternoon live task '10ce362c'.

supersedes_cron_id.description: Always null: the morning stream is new and supersedes nothing.

scheduled_for_et.description: Nominal ET fire time, HH:MM. '09:45' for scheduled morning runs; null for manual runs.

scheduled_window_start_et.description: Inclusive start of the accepted morning window in ET, HH:MM ('09:40').

scheduled_window_end_et.description: Inclusive end of the accepted morning window in ET, HH:MM ('09:50').

triggered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run was triggered.

state_schema_version.description: Morning live contract version tag, pinned to 'morning-live-v1'.

execution_broker.description: The sole execution broker for the morning live stream. Always 'robinhood'.

account_number.description: The Robinhood account number used for morning live execution. Not a secret.

valid_afternoon_evidence.description: Always false. A morning artifact is NEVER valid afternoon scheduled-live evidence; morning fills feed the afternoon stream only as prior same-day allocation context for the top-up guard.

afternoon_live_cron_id.description: The afternoon live task id ('10ce362c') recorded for cross-reference only.
